disambiguation: Not a local AI tool; it is a synchronization layer that connects the vault to the Knowz platform.
extras: Requires a Knowz account and API key; the key is stored in plain text in the vault.
intentEvidence: This connects it to Knowz and turns it into something you can ask.
motivation: The author built it to turn the user's existing vault into a queryable knowledge base.
problem: Static Markdown notes lack the ability to be semantically searched or queried by AI agents across a large corpus.

relations.evidence: Connect your vault to Knowz for semantic search, vector retrieval, agentic RAG, and AI chat grounded in your own notes.

summary: Connect the Obsidian vault to the Knowz service, enabling semantic search, vector retrieval, and AI chat grounded in local notes.
